milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate to and visually observe the potted blue orchid placed inside the open gazebo at spawn-relative (8, 3, 8). max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually walk to the gazebo (orchid is ~11.7 blocks from spawn, so they can't satisfy this from spawn). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking toward the orchid, verifying visual identification rather than just proximity.
